g.text: C23 callback producer: exact landing and delayed result custody
allowed after fresh-root close while producer remains live
session identity outside captured Scheme frames
single authorized attempt; not marker-based idempotence
receipt before settlement; no blind retry
publish new before freeing old; track both lifetimes
normal known completion or retained OperationId
still require collective, join, roots and descriptor grace
owner transfer is not disposal; snapshots can outlive interpreter fields
